annotation.title_clean: Council Decision (EU) 2024/2218 on the signing, on behalf of the European Union, of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law
annotation.title_en: Council Decision (EU) 2024/2218 on the signing, on behalf of the European Union, of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Council Decision authorising the EU's signing of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI, subject to later conclusion. It explains that the Convention will be implemented via the EU AI Act and other Union law, sets out exclusive EU competence, excludes national security, and addresses voting and coordination in the Conference of the Parties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Article 1 authorises signing of the CoE Framework Convention on AI on behalf of the EU, subject to conclusion.
The Commission shall ensure the signing.
The Convention is to be implemented in the EU through the AI Act and other relevant Union law.
The EU has exclusive external competence; national security activities are excluded.
The EU aims for 27 votes in the Conference of the Parties, with enhanced coordination with Member States.
